evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep: 'May I know who am I speaking with, please.' Customer: 'Jacqueline later.' Rep: 'Thank you, Jacqueline.' and later 'Okay, no problem, I'll put you on the higher range right now, okay? And typically for a home visa, Jacqueline...'
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep: 'I just need to ask some questions about. It might take about ten to fifteen minutes. Is this a good time?' — framing present with time-box but no mention of dependable quote or clear wait for confirmation before pivoting.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Rep: 'we of course, talk to a lot of customers everyday and some of their concerns are either movers not arriving on time or damages to their items. Are there any of your concerns as well?' — Asked before any probing started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer stated 'No, I'm just trying to get pricing right now. I don't, haven't even really thought about my concerns.' — No concerns raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Rep: 'First is our no worries damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages...unlike our competitors...we already have that included in the price.' and 'lastly on time guarantee if we run late we provide discounts for your move...no hidden fees of any type...only charge in fifteen minute increments.' Both On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage delivered in recognizable form.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. No close-the-loop question asked.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Rep asked about items most concerned about implicitly, then gathered: addresses and property type (two story homes), bedroom count (4 to 5), additional rooms (palmon area/kitchen), garage/storage/outside furniture. Gathered walking distance? Not explicitly asked. Special considerations? Addressed via garage inventory detail. Largely complete.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Rep: 'And are you also interested in packing services like helping you pack your stuff into boxes?' and 'typically for a home this size, we might end up with about $115 to $135 boxes in total...Do you think you would follow within that range or do you think you'll have more?' Both asked.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Pricing contrast: 'You don't have to pay extra for any trucks that we add-on your move. You only pay for the hourly rate of the guy since our hourly rate are all inclusive rates.' Fee transparency: Trip/overnight/packing materials disclosed ($450 typical for packing supplies), 2.5-hour minimum mentioned. Cameron's no-notes line: 'Oh, okay, yes, yes ma'am, I'll send everything in...Everything will be in an email to you.' All three elements present.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep: 'usually take six and a half to eight and a half hours with four guys...I'll just quote it like an $8.08 per day. That's an almost like $3,994 for the packing portion including the packing supplies and then $3,536 for the moving portion.' Personalization: 'for a home this size four bedroom...your items outside in the garage as well.' Range given and personalized.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep stated: 'Sundays Tuesdays to Thursdays are just the same rate. So it's $104 per hour per mover' but customer already booked Tuesday November 3rd at the start of the call. No indication Tuesday is a Best Value Day or a more expensive day. No value day comparison or flexibility ask made. Not addressed adequately.
evidence_quotes.prep_and_temperature_check: Rep did not deliver the Save Your Ass framing about preparation being the biggest factor in move time. Rep did not ask 'How do you feel about that?' with silence held. Neither element present.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Step 6 was skipped. Rep moved directly to scheduling the walkthrough without asking 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: No final concerns check was conducted, so no follow-up opportunity arose.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Step 7 was not conducted. Rep scheduled the walkthrough without asking 'Would you like our help with your move?' and without mentioning rate lock or no deposit. The customer did book (scheduled the walkthrough for tomorrow at 11:30), but the rep never explicitly asked for the business.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details early and efficiently, asking the two-concerns question before probing and covering all major detail items (addresses, bedroom counts, garage/outdoor items, packing interest, and box count estimates), building a clear picture of the move scope.
coaching_note: You routed to the walkthrough correctly, but you skipped step 6 (final concerns check) and step 7 (asking for the business) entirely — even though the customer booked on the call, the rubric requires you to ask for the business first; also, you did not close the loop after delivering the two promises by asking 'Does that put those to rest?'
